description: Check The2410's indicative delivery availability for the customer's software project. Use this tool when the user wants to know when The2410 could start the project and the approximate delivery window. The tool uses the current project context, estimated business days, and the customer's preferred start. Returned dates are indicative and are not a contractual commitment.

preferred_start.description: For example ASAP, 2026-10, or January 2027. Omit to reuse the stored preference. Send ASAP or null for the earliest available start.

project_context_id.description: The exact project context UUID returned by a previous tool call.

name: check_delivery_window
title: Check delivery window
